lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A semi-regular grid of high-luminance, roughly circular spots arranged in at least five discernible vertical columns and four horizontal rows posterior to the branchial region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Subtle vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the horizontal rows of spots, particularly visible in the mid-flank area posterior to the gills.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal ridge runs along the upper third of the flank, exhibiting a sharp vertical luminance gradient with a high-intensity dorsal edge and a shadowed ventral boundary.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The visible portion of the first dorsal fin exhibits a distribution of approximately six to eight distinct high-luminance spots across its silhouette.

other_distinctive_markers: Two elongated, low-luminance features are visible: one adjacent to the anterior gill slit and another on the upper posterior flank.
